title: provider_runs_decide input
description: The provider's answer to a paid run waiting for it: approve, payment_needed or decline.

reservation_id.description: The waiting run's reservation ID, from run.approval_requested.

decision.description: approve: the run may go ahead. payment_needed: ask the consumer to pay first (needs payment); the run keeps waiting and a later ask replaces this one. decline: release the run.

unit.description: approve only: plan (the plan's unit price) or overage (a subscription's overage_price, for a run beyond its included calls).

standing.description: approve only: also give a standing approval for this consumer, capability and plan, of which this run is the first. runs, until, or both.

runs.description: Runs it covers, this one included.

until.description: When it ends, at most a year away. Timestamp, ISO 8601 with time zone.

payment.description: payment_needed only: your payment request (url, amount, currency, description, challenge).

reason.description: decline only: why, at most 200 characters; the consumer sees it.
